_comment: Settings for rodin_backend.py. Items marked (live) were seen in the signed-in UI on 2026-10-22, (code) were read from the Rodin web client's JavaScript bundle (string literals/logic), (unverified) were neither; see probe/20261022T-signed-in/FINDINGS.md.
directions_status: best effort: the #oripopup picker (live labels) did not open on hover/click of a thumbnail on 2026-10-22; Rodin multi-view is pose-free so unset directions are recorded (upload_info.directions_assigned) and the run continues
mesh_mode_status: (code) UI mode Triangle = API mesh_export_type Raw, unreduced 'detailed sharp triangular mesh'; the polygon-count override only applies when Simplify is on. Smart Low-poly (2 credits) is never used. The confirm popover itself is unverified (no model at that stage existed)
export_status: (live) Pack panel: format radios .obj .fbx .glb .usdz .stl; Geometry checkboxes Base Model / LOD / High-poly; Material checkboxes Shaded + PBR (both ticked by default, a past manual export had a _shaded and a _pbr GLB) and 2K / 4K radios
expected_costs_status: (live+code) a paid step stops unless the displayed cost equals the value here (or --expect-cost kind=N) and the running total stays within budget_credits. The Free Preview click additionally requires the Generate hover to read 'Free Preview', which holds for Extreme-Low, Low, Medium only
cost_table_status: generate hover prices (live 2026-10-22, empty workspace); the rest from the web client's code literals. Cheapest downloadable path = Medium or lower (free preview) + 0.5 geometry confirm = 0.5 total; High adds 0.5 at generate.
